title: High Sensitivity miRNA Illumina Library Preparation Protocol
author: Karen Yip
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6abhae

steps.title: Thaw Mix C300
steps.instruction: Remove Mix C300 from –20 °C storage, allow it to equilibrate to room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.

steps.title: Preheat Thermal Cyclers
steps.instruction: Set one thermal cycler to 70 °C and, if a second cycler is available, set it to 25 °C.

steps.title: Denature RNA Sample
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble the RNA sample components in a sterile 200 µL PCR tube, vortex thoroughly, incubate at 70 °C for 1 minute, then immediately place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Set Up 3′ Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: On ice, combine the 3′‑adapter ligation reagents (note: Mix C300 is highly viscous; pipette slowly). Vortex, pulse‑spin, then incubate at 25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Vortex TailorMag Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the TailorMag Purification Beads (TPB) until they are evenly suspended.

steps.title: Prepare 80% Ethanol Rinse
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh 80 % ethanol for the subsequent rinse step.

steps.title: Add TPB to Ligated Sample
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL TPB to each 3′‑adapter‑ligated sample, vortex, pulse‑spin, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes. Do NOT perform strong centrifugation.

steps.title: Bind Sample to Magnetic Stand
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard 40 µL of the supernatant without disturbing the TPB pellet (sample recovery may be affected if the pellet is disrupted).

steps.title: Rinse TPB Pellet
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnetic stand, gently add 150 µL 80 % ethanol, pipette up and down once without disrupting the pellet, then discard the rinse solution. Point the tip opposite the pellet.

steps.title: Air‑Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the TPB pellet at room temperature until it changes from glossy/wet to matte (approximately 5–15 minutes). Over‑drying to a powdery appearance should be avoided.

steps.title: Resuspend Dried Beads
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Add Water and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add 7 µL nuclease‑free water to the dried TPB pellet, vortex to resuspend, pulse‑spin, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Set Up 5′ Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble the 5′‑adapter ligation reaction, gently pipette to mix, vortex, pulse‑spin, incubate at 25 °C for 1 hour, then place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Set Up cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble the cDNA synthesis reaction, vortex, pulse‑spin, incubate at 50 °C for 1 hour, then place the tube on ice. (First‑strand cDNA may be stored at –20 °C for up to 7 days.)

steps.title: Set Up PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: In a fresh sterile 200 µL PCR tube on ice, set up the PCR using 5 µL of cDNA and a single index primer per sample (10–100 ng input RNA recommended). Vortex, pulse‑spin. Presence of TPB does not interfere.

steps.title: Run PCR Cycling
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tube in a thermal cycler and run: 98 °C 30 s; 15 cycles of 98 °C 5 s, 60 °C 15 s, 72 °C 1 min; final 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C. (PCR products may be stored at –20 °C for up to 7 days.)

steps.title: Assess PCR Yield
steps.instruction: Mix 1 µL PCR product with 9 µL nuclease‑free water and run on an Agilent BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity DNA assay. Expect a distinct peak near 140 bp.

steps.title: Prepare 1X TBE Buffer
steps.instruction: Determine the required volume and dilute 5X TBE buffer to 1X for gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Assemble Gel Apparatus
steps.instruction: Set up the electrophoresis apparatus for an 8 % PAGE gel.

steps.title: Prepare Ladder Mixes
steps.instruction: Mix 2 µL Custom Ladder with 2 µL Hi‑Density TBE Sample Buffer. (Optional) Mix 1 µL 100 bp DNA ladder with 1 µL Hi‑Density TBE Sample Buffer.

steps.title: Add Loading Buffer to PCR Product
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL Hi‑Density TBE Sample Buffer to 25 µL PCR product, then vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Load Sample onto Gel
steps.instruction: Load 25 µL of the PCR‑product‑buffer mix into a central well of the 8 % PAGE gel.

steps.title: Load Custom Ladder
steps.instruction: Load 2 µL of the custom ladder‑dye mix into the wells flanking each PCR product lane (bracket each lane).

steps.title: Optional Load 100bp Ladder
steps.instruction: If desired, load 2 µL of the 100 bp ladder‑dye mix into a separate well.

steps.title: Run PAGE Gel
steps.instruction: Run the gel for 75 minutes at 145 V, then immediately remove it from the apparatus.

steps.title: Prepare TE‑Tween Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare TE buffer containing 0.1 % Tween‑20.

steps.title: Stain Gel with Ethidium Bromide
steps.instruction: Open the gel cassette and stain with 1 µg/mL ethidium bromide solution according to the manufacturer’s instructions. (Alternative) Stain with SYBR Gold as described by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Visualize Gel on UV
steps.instruction: Place the stained gel on a UV transilluminator (or Dark Reader for SYBR Gold) and observe the banding pattern.

steps.title: Place Gel Breaker Tube
steps.instruction: Insert the gel breaker tube into a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Excise Desired Gel Band
steps.instruction: Align the gel cutter tool with the 140 bp band (or include the 150 bp band if desired) using the custom ladder as reference, press firmly, and excise the gel fragment.

steps.title: Insert Gel Slice into Breaker
steps.instruction: Place the gel cutter containing the excised slice into the gel breaker tube.

steps.title: Pulse‑Spin Gel Assembly
steps.instruction: Pulse‑spin the gel cutter and breaker assembly in a minifuge to collect the gel slice in the breaker tube.

steps.title: Discard Gel Cutter
steps.instruction: Remove the gel cutter from the assembly and discard it.

steps.title: Add TE‑Tween to Gel Slice
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL TE buffer with 0.1 % Tween‑20 to the gel breaker tube containing the gel slice.

steps.title: Centrifuge Gel Breaker Assembly
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the assembly at maximum speed (~13 000 × g) for 2 minutes at room temperature until all gel passes through the holes into the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute Library Overnight
steps.instruction: Shake the tube at 600 rpm at room temperature overnight (≈18 hours). Do NOT heat the gel‑buffer mixture.

steps.title: Spin Gel Mix to Collect Eluate
steps.instruction: After overnight incubation, spin the gel mix at maximum speed (~13 000 × g) for 2 minutes to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Transfer Eluate to New Tube
steps.instruction: Using a P10 pipette, gently transfer 20–25 µL of eluate to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Bioanalyzer Quality Control
steps.instruction: Load 1 µL of the resuspended library onto an Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip. Note that residual gel‑loading dye may appear as a high‑molecular‑weight peak but does not affect sequencing; sizing accuracy is ±10 %.
